```{r}
#| include: false
# This template is shared by the construct reports. Each report page sets:
#   score, item_names, subscales, lo, hi   (see the top of rwa.qmd, for example)
label   <- score_names[[score]]
waves   <- sort(unique(d$wave[!is.na(d[[score]])]))   # waves in which the score exists
cs_wave <- min(waves)                                  # first wave = cross-sectional analysis
dcs     <- d[d$wave == cs_wave, ]
items_r <- paste0(item_names, "_r")
```

## Study characteristics

Study E is a five-wave online panel of `r length(unique(d$exercise_id))` pseudonymous respondents in Germany. All respondents in this extract took part in all five waves, so the sample is a **selected group of panel stayers**, not a probability sample. Results are unweighted and describe this sample only.

**Items** (wording and rules from `spec/item_spec.csv`):

```{r}
item_table <- spec[match(item_names, ifelse(is.na(spec$item_no), spec$item_stem,
                                            paste0(spec$item_stem, "_", spec$item_no))), ]
show_table(data.frame(Item = item_names, Wording = item_table$wording,
                      Waves = gsub(";", ", ", item_table$waves),
                      Range = paste0(item_table$scale_min, "-", item_table$scale_max),
                      `Reversed in pipeline` = ifelse(item_table$reverse == 1, "yes", "no"),
                      `Special codes` = item_table$documented_missing_codes,
                      check.names = FALSE))
```

**Score.** The mean of the recoded items (range `r lo`-`r hi`, higher = more of the construct), computed when at least two thirds of the items were answered. Special codes (for example 97 "not able to answer") count as missing.

## Data quality

```{r}
quality <- NULL
for (it in item_names) {
  for (w in waves) {
    raw <- d[[it]][d$wave == w]
    quality <- rbind(quality, data.frame(
      Item = it, Wave = w,
      Blank = sum(is.na(raw)),
      `Special code` = sum(!is.na(raw) & !(raw %in% as.character(lo:hi))),
      Valid = sum(!is.na(d[[paste0(it, "_r")]][d$wave == w])),
      check.names = FALSE))
  }
}
show_table(quality)
```

**Analytic N** (respondents with a valid score) per wave: `r paste0("W", waves, " = ", sapply(waves, function(w) sum(!is.na(d[[score]][d$wave == w]))), collapse = "; ")`.

## Psychometric evidence

```{r}
if (length(item_names) == 1) {
  cat("Single-item measure: internal consistency cannot be estimated.",
      "See the validity and stability evidence elsewhere in this report.")
} else {
  sets <- c(setNames(list(item_names), score), subscales)
  rel  <- NULL
  for (s in names(sets)) {
    for (w in waves) {
      rel <- rbind(rel, data.frame(Score = s, Wave = w, reliability(d[d$wave == w, ], sets[[s]]),
                                   check.names = FALSE))
    }
  }
  show_table(rel)
}
```

## Demographics (wave `r cs_wave`)

Groups with fewer than `r MIN_CELL` respondents are hidden.

```{r}
demo <- NULL
for (g in c("gender", "age_group", "education", "income_group", "east_west")) {
  groups <- group_means(dcs, score, g)
  if (!is.null(groups)) demo <- rbind(demo, data.frame(Variable = g, groups))
}
show_table(demo)
```

**Adjusted model.** Linear regression of the score on age (per 10 years), gender, education, household income (1-13) and left-right self-placement. Categories with fewer than `r MIN_CELL` respondents are left out.

```{r}
md <- dcs
for (g in c("gender", "education")) {           # leave out very small categories
  counts <- table(md[[g]])
  md[[g]][md[[g]] %in% names(counts)[counts < MIN_CELL]] <- NA
}
md$age_10 <- md$age / 10
predictors <- c("age_10", "gender", "education", "income", "ideology")
predictors <- predictors[sapply(predictors, function(p) length(unique(na.omit(md[[p]]))) > 1)]
fit <- lm(reformulate(predictors, response = score), data = md)
ci  <- confint(fit)
show_table(data.frame(Term = names(coef(fit)), b = coef(fit),
                      `95% CI` = sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", ci[, 1], ci[, 2]),
                      p = summary(fit)$coefficients[, 4], check.names = FALSE), digits = 3)
```

n = `r nobs(fit)`; R² = `r round(summary(fit)$r.squared, 2)`; adjusted R² = `r round(summary(fit)$adj.r.squared, 2)`.

## Longitudinal evidence

```{r}
#| results: asis
if (length(waves) < 2) cat("The score exists in one wave only, so there is no longitudinal analysis.")
```

```{r}
#| eval: !expr length(waves) > 1
#| fig-height: 3.2
#| fig-width: 7
flagged_ids <- unique(d$exercise_id[d$att_flag == 1])
means <- rbind(cbind(wave_means(d, score), Sample = "All respondents"),
               cbind(wave_means(d[!d$exercise_id %in% flagged_ids, ], score),
                     Sample = "Never flagged by an attention check"))
ggplot(means, aes(Wave, Mean, colour = Sample, group = Sample)) +
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(.3)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), position = position_dodge(.3)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = paste(label, "(mean, 95% CI)"), colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
#| eval: !expr length(waves) > 1
x <- score_by_wave(d, score)
pairs <- list()
for (i in 1:(ncol(x) - 1)) pairs[[i]] <- c(i, i + 1)        # adjacent waves
if (ncol(x) > 2) pairs[[length(pairs) + 1]] <- c(1, ncol(x)) # first to last wave
change <- NULL
for (p in pairs) {
  diff <- x[[p[2]]] - x[[p[1]]]
  diff <- diff[!is.na(diff)]
  ci   <- t.test(diff)$conf.int
  change <- rbind(change, data.frame(
    Comparison = paste(names(x)[p[1]], "to", names(x)[p[2]]), n = length(diff),
    `Mean change` = mean(diff), `95% CI` = sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", ci[1], ci[2]),
    d_z = mean(diff) / sd(diff), check.names = FALSE))
}
show_table(change)
```

**Rank-order stability** (correlation of the score between waves):

```{r}
#| eval: !expr length(waves) > 1
stab <- round(cor(x, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"), 2)
stab[upper.tri(stab)] <- NA
show_table(data.frame(Wave = names(x), stab, check.names = FALSE))
```

**Robustness: balanced panel vs. available cases.** Balanced = respondents with a valid score in every wave in which the score exists.

```{r}
#| eval: !expr length(waves) > 1
balanced <- complete.cases(x)
show_table(data.frame(Wave = names(x),
                      `Available n` = colSums(!is.na(x)), `Available mean` = colMeans(x, na.rm = TRUE),
                      `Balanced n` = sum(balanced), `Balanced mean` = colMeans(x[balanced, ]),
                      check.names = FALSE))
```

**Random-intercept model.** How much of the variation is stable between persons (ICC), and the average change per wave.

```{r}
#| eval: !expr length(waves) > 1
ml <- d[!is.na(d[[score]]), c("exercise_id", "wave", score)]
names(ml)[3] <- "y"
ml$wave_from_start <- ml$wave - min(ml$wave)
m  <- lme4::lmer(y ~ wave_from_start + (1 | exercise_id), data = ml)
vc <- as.data.frame(lme4::VarCorr(m))$vcov
ci <- confint(m, parm = "wave_from_start", method = "Wald")
show_table(data.frame(Persons = length(unique(ml$exercise_id)), Observations = nrow(ml),
                      ICC = vc[1] / sum(vc),
                      `Change per wave` = lme4::fixef(m)[["wave_from_start"]],
                      `95% CI` = sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", ci[1], ci[2]), check.names = FALSE), digits = 3)
```
